string-array.name: accordion_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by consolidating all 52 cards into a single pile.
**Lose** when no card can move.
## Gameplay
A card can be consolidated onto the card **one or three spaces before it** when they share a **rank or suit**.
The cards wrap left to right, top to bottom.

string-array.name: aces_up_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Discard the whole deck except the four Aces (one per pile).
## Gameplay
Tap a card to discard it when another pile shows a **higher card of the same suit**.
**Aces are high** and can never be discarded.
When a pile is empty, tap any other top card to move it there.
When you\'re stuck, tap **Deal** for one more card on each pile.

string-array.name: augury_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Work out the **hidden law** well enough to make **eight correct guesses in a row**. The arc at the left fills with each.
## Gameplay
Each game has a secret law about which cards may follow the last card(s) on the path.
- Tap a card in your hand if you think it fits the law. If it does, it joins the path; if not, it lies greyed out beside the last card.

- If you think no card in your hand fits, tap the crossed-out card. If you\'re right, you get a new hand; if a card did fit, it is played for you (shown in red), and your run of correct guesses is reset.
For all laws: A = 1, Jacks = 11, Queens = 12, Kings = 13.
## Laws
- Must be the same colour
- Must alternate colour
- Must be the same suit or rank
- Must be a different suit
- Must alternate between odd and even ranks
- Must be higher rank; anything can follow J, Q or K
- Must be within two ranks
- Must be within two ranks (Ace and King are neighbours)
- Must be at least three ranks apart
- Must alternate between high (8–K) and low (A–7)
- Must alternate between court and number cards
- Must be lower rank; anything can follow an Ace
- Odds must follow odds, evens must follow evens
- Must follow suits in order: spades, hearts, diamonds, clubs
- Same suit as the last must be higher; the other suit of its colour must be lower; the other colour can follow anything
- Red cards must be 8 or higher; black cards must be 7 or lower

string-array.name: baroness_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by discarding all 52 cards.
**Lose** when the stock is empty and no move is left.
## Gameplay
Tap a **King**, or two top cards that add up to **13**, to discard them. Aces are worth 1, Jacks 11, and Queens 12.
To fill an empty pile, tap a card, then the empty pile.
When stuck, tap **Deal** to deal one per pile.

string-array.name: beehive_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Clear all 52 cards by gathering sets of four cards of the same rank.
## Gameplay
The six piles in the middle hold one rank each. A set of four is cleared at once.
The **beehive** is on the left; the **waste** runs down the right. The stock is not shown.
Tap the beehive or the waste to move its top card onto a pile of the same rank, or else into an empty pile.
Tap a pile to join it to another pile of the same rank.
Tap **Draw** to turn up three cards from the stock onto the waste. When the stock runs out, **Recycle** turns the waste back over, and draws again.

string-array.name: clock_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Turn every card face up, sorting all 52 to their hours, before all four Kings come up.
## Gameplay
Tap the middle pile to turn up its top card.
Then tap the pile that card belongs to: Aces at 1 o\'clock, numbers at their hour, Jacks at 11, Queens at 12 and Kings in the middle.

string-array.name: dominion_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by reducing all fifteen cards to a single card on the board.
**Lose** when no conquest is possible, or when one of the cards on the board has no possible match left.
## Gameplay
Tap a card, then tap a card of the **same rank or suit** next to it (diagonals count) to conquer it.
A card may also conquer a card further along the same row or column when every space between them is empty.
Each deal uses three of the four suits, and every card has at least one match to begin with.

string-array.name: ebb_and_flow_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Play all **52 cards** onto the four piles.
## Gameplay
Play cards onto the rising (first two) or falling (last two) piles, using cards of the same rank or higher/lower.
Any card can start an empty pile. Aces are worth 1.
A card **one rank back and in the same suit** can also be played.
If your hand has 5 cards or less, you can **draw** to fill your hand back up to seven.

string-array.name: elevens_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Win by clearing the whole deck, in pairs that total **11**, or in royal **Jack-Queen-King** triplets.
## Gameplay
Tap two cards that total 11: **A and 10, 2 and 9, 3 and 8, 4 and 7, 5 and 6**.
For face cards, tap one Jack, one Queen and one King, which will be removed together.

resources.string: No pair or royal triplet left

string-array.name: fifteen_puzzle_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Arrange each row from Ace to 4, by suit:
- **Hearts**
- **Clubs**
- **Diamonds**
- **Spades** (there is no 4 of Spades)
## Gameplay
Tap a card above, below, left or right of the gap to slide it into the gap.
Cards turn green when they are in their place.
Every puzzle is shuffled with legal moves, so it can always be solved.

string-array.name: fortunes_call_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Score 20 points by making correct guesses before making three wrong calls.
## Gameplay
Predict the colour of the face-down card, or its rank relative to the face up card.
Correct **Red** or **Black** guesses score 1 point.
Correct **Higher** or **Lower** guesses score 2 points.
Equal ranks are neither higher nor lower.

string-array.name: tower_of_hanoi_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Build one pile ordered from **9** to **Ace**.
## Gameplay
Tap a pile to pick up its top card, then tap another pile to move it there.
A card can be moved to an empty pile, or on a card of **higher rank**.
There is no losing: keep moving until the tower is built.

string-array.name: jailbreak_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Free the Joker from the middle: empty one of the four **walls** (the piles above, below, left and right of the middle) while the middle is empty too.
**Lose** when no cards can be removed and none can be drawn.
## Gameplay
Tap cards to select them. Selected cards are discarded when the **total value of red and black cards** is the same.
When stuck, tap **Draw** to put a card in the middle.
The middle holds at most **three** cards.

string-array.name: lights_out_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Turn all 20 cards face down.
## Gameplay
Tapping a card turns over that card, and orthogonal cards.
Every deal can be solved.

string-array.name: little_windmill_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Move all 52 cards to the four corner foundations.
## Foundations
An **Ace** is taken from the deck to start the first corner. The other three Aces start the other corners as they come up.
Build each foundation **up by suit**, from Ace to King.
## The Cross
Five cards are dealt to the cross. Build its piles **down, regardless of suit**. Nothing goes on an Ace.
Any available card may fill an empty space in the cross.
## Draw and Waste
Tap **Draw** to turn the stock one card at a time onto the **waste**, at the left. There is no redeal.

string-array.name: lycan_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Empty the **Wolf\'s hand** (top) each round, and race the Wolf to **100 points**.
## Capturing
Tap your cards (bottom) and the Wolf\'s cards to pick a capture. The next card to be drawn is on the pile at the left.
- **Perfect:** one of your cards takes a Wolf card of the same rank. You draw the next card.
- **Sum:** two or more of your cards add up to one Wolf card. You draw the next card.
- **Split:** one of your cards equals several Wolf cards added up. The Wolf draws the next card.
- **Over:** one of your cards takes a lower Wolf card. The Wolf draws the difference in cards.
You can **Fold** at any time to end the round. It can be advantageous to fold early, to limit the Wolf\'s score.
## Scoring
Empty the Wolf\'s hand to score the value of the cards left in your hand.
Otherwise, the Wolf scores the value of the cards left in its hand.
This is an addictive, but very difficult game.

string-array.name: memory_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Clear the board by finding all matching pairs.
## Matching
Tap a card to turn it over, then tap a second card.
A pair must match in **both rank and suit**.

string-array.name: nestor_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by pairing off all 32 cards.
## Gameplay
Tap two free cards of the **same rank** to discard them.
Only the top card of a column, or the two reserve cards, can be used.
Only **Aces to 8s** are used.

string-array.name: ouroboros_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
- Loot all four **jewels** (Aces) and escape alive by stepping onto the **exit** (Joker).
- Landing on a **trap** (J, Q, K) while it is face up means instant death.
- Collect **trinkets** (2 to 10) for extra points.
## The Loop
The dungeon is a loop of cards around the screen. Its **top card** is at the bottom. You explore by counting forward from the top card.
- Landing on a **face down** card is always safe and does nothing.
- Landing on a **face up** card triggers it: a jewel or trinket is collected; a trap kills you; the exit lets you out once you hold all four jewels.
- Card suits have no meaning.
## Actions
- **Look around:** tap the top card while it\'s face down to turn it and the next one up.
- **Pick:** tap either of the top two cards, face up, to pick it.
- **Explore:** with a number card picked, you can explore down the dungeon by a number of cards equal to its value. Tap the purple card to go there.
- **Mark a path:** with a number card picked, tap an empty path (one of the three maps) to set it aside there.
- **Return to a path:** tap a marked path to put its card back on top of the loop, picked.
## Tips
- **Mark paths whenever you can!** If the top two cards aren\'t number cards and you have no marked path, you are lost.
- Marking and returning paths, several times in a row, lets you change the top cards, to control how far you go and where you land.

resources.string: You got all four jewels and found the exit!
Lost in the dungeon, with your loot.
Lost in the dungeon, with no way out!

string-array.name: ozanams_square_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Fill the square so that each **row, column and long diagonal** holds **one card of each rank and one of each suit**.
## Gameplay
- The cards to place lie in a pile for each suit, at the right. Tap a pile to pick its top card; tap it again for the next card of that suit.
- Then tap an empty space to place it. Cards dealt into place (shown in black) can\'t be moved.
- Cards you place can be moved to another space, swapped, or sent back by tapping their pile.
- A card that repeats a rank or suit in one of its lines is marked in red.
- Every deal has **exactly one** solution.

string-array.name: rogue_run_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Get through every room before your health runs out.
## Card Types
- **Black cards are monsters.** Fighting one costs health equal to its value (J: 11, Q: 12, K: 13, A: 14).
- **Diamonds are weapons.** A weapon takes its value off each monster\'s damage. After it kills a monster it can only fight monsters of **equal or lower** value than the last one it killed.
- **Hearts are potions** and heal you by their value, up to 20.
## Rooms
- Tap a room card, and confirm/choose its action. You can double tap to act on non-monster cards.
- With a monster picked, **Fist** fights that monster barehanded, while **Wpn** uses the equipped weapon for lower damage, if available.
- Resolve any three cards of a room to move on; the fourth stays for the next room.
- With no card picked, **Run** puts the whole room at the bottom of the dungeon. You can\'t run from two rooms in a row.
## Scoring
Your score is equal to your health left, plus a bonus when you finish with an unused potion while at full health.

string-array.name: royal_marriage_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
Discard every card except the **Queen of Hearts** and **King of Hearts**, which must end up side by side.
## Deal
All 52 cards lie in one line, read left to right and then down: the Queen of Hearts first, the King of Hearts last.
## Discarding
- One card, or two side by side, can be discarded if the cards either side of them match in **rank or suit**.
- A longer run can go only if every card in it is of the **same suit**, and the cards either side match in rank or suit.
- Tap the card or cards to remove, then **Discard**. Double-tap a single card to discard it.

resources.string: The Queen and King are wed!

string-array.name: ten_twenty_thirty_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by discarding all 52 cards.
## Gameplay
All 52 cards are dealt face up in one line, read left to right and then down.
Cards count their face value; Jacks, Queens and Kings count **10**.
Any **two or more adjacent cards** in the line that total **10, 20 or 30** can be discarded.

string-array.name: triple_stack_rules
string-array.item: ## Objective
**Win** by using up every ingredient to serve sandwiches.
**Lose** when no sandwich can be made while ingredients remain.
## Serving
Tap three cards with **equally spaced ranks**, then **Serve**. Aces, Jacks, Queens and Kings are 1, 11, 12 and 13.
Ranks wrap from King to Ace, so for example: 9 / Q / 2 makes a valid sandwich.
## Refills
After serving, the number of ingredients that refill your hand depends on the quality of the sandwich served:
- Four for a sandwich made from one suit
- Three for a sandwich made from one color
- Two for any other
